independence.review_basis: Frozen candidate source and sole design README; parent progress messages did not replace independent inspection. No later candidate or proposed fix is treated as part of candidate07.

production_interface_review.scope: Native/backend extraction, evidence publication, queue drain, synchronous terminal update, save/load callbacks, packed label/time/ACK inputs and raw causal snapshot boundary; read relevant call paths. Native algorithm internals outside those boundaries were not re-proved.

test_interface_review.scope: Reviewed registered targets, test entry points and current-core call/fixture interfaces; targeted assertion bodies were traced for findings. This does not claim every line of every non-core test was read.

coverage.equation_map_assessment: Mapping anchors are navigation claims only. Its complete/self-audited status does not establish semantic coverage or resolve the findings; function bodies and formulas were independently read.

formula_review.assessment: Conditional pipeline composition matches production callbacks and terminal drain, but actual execution is blocked by F-A03 and acceptance by F-A02/F-A04.
Explicit research objective, not a consequence of the stated estimator. No accuracy, information or zero-ghost claim is established by this static review.
Registry has separate identity, current, pending, session-local state, source ledger and evidence ownership. Geometry and evidence are not conflated.
World-coordinate mesh accumulation and min/max clocks match. Closing uses the decision/support upper bound. Reconstruction usage counts are provenance counts, not independent confidence trials.

128-bit extraction scope plus accepted generation, ordered completion slots including empty results, per-identity ledger and checkpoint persistence implement source idempotence. Legacy provenance is explicitly a weaker import contract.
Production pins blocking extraction and waits for decision publication outside the graph lock before advancing backend. Scheduler timing therefore does not select which extraction prefix is ingested.

Binary disagreement loss and tie retention match the local reducer. Inherited/session-local relation and terminal settlement use common relation logic. Validity depends on correctly classified owned evidence; F-A01 affects those inputs.

Continue/successor risks reduce to inside/outside counts on the same reliable point domain. Exact point-to-triangle distance is used. The 0.10 m tube, 30-sample budget, mobility prior and equal unit losses are declared protocol assumptions, not inferred physical laws.
Settlement transports closed histories and pending observations while retaining evidence keys and clocks. Per-fragment evidence ownership is enforced.

Latest eligible candidate uses actual support and the closed-support frontier; absorption checks support membership in the candidate interval. Mere later processing time is not support. F-A04 exposes tests that still assume older handoff semantics.
Only newly consumed native accepted trajectory time can close current; historical motion flags alone are not fresh departure evidence. The consumed time watermark is retained.
Adapter interval reduction preserves finite gaps, latest native right boundary and degenerate boundary anchors; it does not replace native presence inference. Half-open interpretation is stated.

Projection compares radial query distance and encoded radial measurement in a common world frame. Z-depth conversion and pixel source identity are explicit. Classification priority has the unresolved discrepancy F-A01.

Nearest-millimetre range encoding and invalid zero code implement the quantization formula. The error bound is valid for an encoded measured range; it does not derive the extra identity-conditioned 1 mm classifier branch against a continuous query (F-A01).

Copy-on-write evidence snapshot and cutoff bound timestamp enumeration, dense access and point projection. Future active-window measurements cannot enter an earlier backend decision through these interfaces.

Static frame selection uses two-direction actual target-pixel source groups, conservative unknown completion, fixed Beta reference and last decisive incompatible prefix. Its input categories inherit F-A01. Sampling budget and alpha are declared assumptions.

Track preparation consumes the existing native centroid-displacement qualification; low-displacement physical tracks are copied for static extraction. This is an explicit native interface behavior, not evidence of a newly inferred movement model.

For the declared completion family, cancelling counterexample groups before creating retained groups gives K=max(k-U,0), N=n+max(U-k,0). Ordered hypothesis domains make the likelihood-ratio argument valid. Actual-source grouping uses logical AND.

Beta component moments and equal-time/equal-state mixture moment matching match the implementation. The finite-budget variance lower bound follows from total variance; numerical projection is explicitly specified. Conditional IID/exchangeability and ignorable missingness are modeling assumptions.

The code computes normalized truncated retained predictive mass and uniform exited predictive mass, with log-beta integrals and a tail fallback. Binomial factors cancel in odds. Local/global equal prior mixing occurs in probability space.
Strict log-odds > log(99) matches equal hypothesis prior and stated asymmetric decision costs. This is a per-query robust decision, not an anytime false-exit guarantee.

Per-fragment processed watermark bounds new measurements; geometry or clock reset rebuilds current-session evidence for the new query. Calibration and scoring mosaics have separate causal authorization.

Evidence key, geometry revision, support/birth/input watermark and current measurement stamp are checked before reductions. This correct ownership interface is not respected by several existing test fixtures (F-A04).

The mathematical empty authorization domain for unestablished/closed identities is implemented in frame cutting. Its diagnostics incorrectly index unregistered identities through -1, causing F-A03 on ordinary archived data.
Loaded current evidence keys are frozen and compared with final current keys. Pending promotion remains a successor even when its geometry birth predates the new session.

Present TSDF and free-space voting use the same projective residual/truncation/free-limit condition. Current mesh first hit is used, with measured-voxel fallback only when there is no qualified mesh hit.
Equal valid-frame weighted truncated projective TSDF update and fully observed-cube extraction match. This is the declared terminal reconstruction; online native fusion is distinct and retained.
Face-centre supported pixel identity votes choose count, latest support and identity order. Supported source times feed face/vertex timestamps. No bounding-box proximity assigns identity.

Fixed zero-scale correspondence set, upper median, neutral insufficient-data result and deterministic coarse/fine grid search match. Scale is a protocol error estimate; the estimator does not silently rescale TSDF inputs.

Binned absolute residual histogram interpolation, Gaussian conversion constant, nearest original populated-bin inheritance and half-voxel fallback match. Gaussian residual interpretation is an explicit approximation.
Historical and current completion candidates are qualified by state continuity and unintegrated reconstruction domain. The binary historical prior is explicit, not a physical existence guarantee.

Nonnegative scale contribution plus historical source error form the stated correspondence window. Negative scale does not enlarge the window. That one-sided protocol is stated rather than universally derived from all possible depth biases.

Correspondence queries global first hit, then requires physical identity, facing and oriented-normal agreement, spatial window and actual pixel depth support. A failed first hit does not search behind the occluder.

Ordered R/S/F/O/unknown classification matches the stated surface model; actual spherical footprint support and complete-footprint free passage are used. This surface decision is distinct from entity identity evidence.
Ray-sphere intersection defines discrete pixel footprint, including outside-image unknown witnesses. Free passage checks each footprint ray's valid depth and common TSDF legal domain.
Assigned binary disagreement costs directly yield the loss difference. Occluded/unknown observations cancel by construction; this is a modeling choice.

Strict p+S>F+R minimizes stated loss with deletion tie-breaking; a historical vote preserves old geometry under measured S/F ties and no observations. Candidates are assembled only after this decision.

Refusion uses cyclic orientation-preserving exact world-coordinate face keys per physical slot, and current/history/completion priority. The production fingerprint uses a different orientation-erasing equivalence (F-A02).

Exact matched vertices use latest support, earliest nonzero birth and latest-source attributes with documented tie order. Geometry decision and error provenance stay attached to the historical hypothesis.

Chain-bound registry checkpoint retains active current/pending geometry metadata, keys, clocks, source ledgers and transition summaries. Equality is continuation-state equivalence; completed geometry history remains in its owning artifact. Load re-establishes the next-session boundary.

Background obligations bind exact world coordinate plus original mesh timestamp and maximum last support, then use later real rays and native change detection. Rebuilt or re-supported surface does not inherit unrelated old obligations.

Scoring/calibration mosaics, pending authorized calibration statistics, local/global moments and processing watermarks are saved. Batch freezing prevents current traversal order from changing other objects' prior in that same batch.

Project sessionSceneAt uses upper_bound predecessor and returns a clone; before-first is empty. Consumers and seed use this wrapper rather than native getDsgPtr's different temporal projection. Raw compressed snapshots supply the source.

findings.title: Identity-conditioned near-depth occlusion uses an underived 1 mm branch
findings.normal_input_counterexample: A valid old surface query has q=2.000 m, a valid measured radial endpoint rhat=1.980 m, tolerance=0.050 m. Same physical identity returns Supported, but a different physical identity or background returns Occluded at line 31 despite being inside the stated near-depth matching band. With q=2.00075 m and rhat=2.000 m, the 1 mm threshold also treats a different-ID return as a near-depth replacement even though a single encoded range has only +/-0.5 mm quantization uncertainty relative to this continuous query.
findings.reason: Equation (6a) bounds quantization of the measured range. q is a reconstructed continuous geometry distance; it is not a second independently quantized measured range. The prose/table does not specify or derive an identity-conditioned matching domain and priority using this additional 1 mm boundary. This changes both static-frame segmentation and entity contradiction counts. The existence of foreground occlusion is physically legitimate; neither blindly deleting this branch nor asserting every other-ID near return is a replacement is justified by the frozen design.
findings.required_resolution: Define the observation matching/occlusion domains and their priority from the actual measurement/geometry error model, then make the shared classifier and design agree. Include both foreground-other-object and genuine replacement cases.

findings.title: Current-scene fingerprint erases triangle orientation used by inference
findings.normal_input_counterexample: Two ordinary one-triangle meshes have identical vertices and per-vertex attributes, with faces (a,b,c) versus (a,c,b). encodeFace sorts all three encoded vertices, so their canonical current-scene fingerprints are identical. The opposite winding reverses the normal, affects facing/oriented correspondence and is a distinct cyclic face key in equation (14a).
findings.reason: The production seed comparison accepts equivalence under a broader relation than the model actually uses. It therefore cannot establish preservation of the current geometric state through reseeding, even without a hash collision.
findings.required_resolution: Canonicalize each face by cyclic rotation while retaining winding, and update the fingerprint contract/fixture to accept reindexing but distinguish reversed winding.

findings.title: Cutting an unestablished physical identity indexes starts[-1]
findings.normal_input_counterexample: An early valid archived frame contains stable ID 2, whose brief/small observation produces no accepted static object mesh (native minimum-volume or empty-reconstruction rejection). Registry state_starts consequently has no ID 2. ID 1 has an accepted current state born after that early frame, or any registry identity is closed, so that frame enters before. SessionFrames initializes unknown ID 2 start to UINT64_MAX and cut removes its nonzero range and records removed[2]. start_index[2] is still -1; starts[start_index[2]].cut performs an out-of-bounds atomic access.
findings.reason: The archive intentionally preserves valid physical candidates before object extraction, and the design explicitly assigns unestablished identities an empty authorization domain. Absence from registry is a normal input state. The diagnostic counter path assumes every cut identity has a registry Start and violates that domain.
findings.required_resolution: Keep unknown-identity cuts valid while accounting for them without indexing a nonexistent Start. Verify the same authorization path with accepted, closed and unestablished identities together.

findings.title: Registered tests still construct obsolete evidence and invalid archive camera fixtures
findings.normal_input_counterexample: The existing support-clock fixture sets support_rays and latest_support_stamp=5 s, then calls resolveCurrentEvidence at 20 s, but leaves evidence_key=0, revision/watermark default. The current reducer must reject it and cannot satisfy the expected confirmed clock. The disappearance fixture likewise expects rejected evidence to close current. Separately, testArchive creates a 64x48 camera with fx=fy=50 but leaves min_range=max_range=0; save succeeds and current load necessarily returns false at Camera.valid, contradicting the fixture assertion.
findings.reason: These fixtures are registered and invoked. Some are stale structurally (missing ownership metadata), and the empty-evidence direct handoff case is stale semantically against the current reducer. App recurrence and temporal-fragment helpers repeat the ownership omission. This is a project validation failure, not a reason to weaken production ownership or to classify malformed production input as a new algorithm defect.
findings.required_resolution: Migrate fixtures to the actual evidence owner/revision/watermark interface and valid camera contract, preserve explicit rejection tests, and replace obsolete empty-evidence expectations with the frozen model semantics before opening ctest/offline gates.

model_assumptions_not_project_defects: Stable cross-session physical IDs, camera/pose correspondence and stated input protocol are prerequisites.

Source-group Bernoulli conditional IID, calibration transfer, ignorable missingness, equal-loss geometry comparison, mobility prior and fixed sample budgets are declared modeling assumptions. They are not guarantees under arbitrary real-world motion or occlusion.
The one-sided positive-scale correspondence model and historical one-vote prior are documented protocols. Static inspection alone does not prove their empirical accuracy.

Native minimum-volume, reconstruction and motion qualification can legitimately reject a physical track. F-A03 is the project failure to handle the resulting absent registry state, not a native-extractor defect.
Native getDsgPtr has different timeline behavior; the project causal wrapper correctly uses raw snapshots. No native algorithm rewrite is requested.

production_chain_assessment.static_wiring: Present and coherent: same bootstrap/recurrent backend, packed identity protocol, time contract, bounded transaction ACK, terminal drain before state save, chain-bound sidecars and commit bundle.
production_chain_assessment.executable_acceptance: Not approved: normal refusion UB plus known fixture/interface failures. Fingerprint also cannot establish orientation-preserving seed equivalence.
production_chain_assessment.offline_contract: Saved-frame/supplied-final-state refusion is a conditional surface replay; it does not establish end-to-end state inference, A/B/C recurrence quality, or equation (2). No replay was executed.

gates.reason: Resolve F-A01/F-A03 model and normal-input execution defects, F-A04 current-interface tests and F-A02 acceptance equivalence first. This review performed no compilation and does not assert a compiler failure.
gates.re_review_required: Freeze the resulting source and design together; independently review changed mechanisms and current-interface tests before opening build/offline gates.
